title: Council Order 0015479: barrier-free requirement for a south exit door in a two-storey building
jurisdiction: Alberta; accredited municipality not named in the order (respondent is an accredited agency)
code_edition: Alberta Building Code 2006 (order cites Division B 9.5.2); the appellant refers to the 2014 ABC section 3.8.1.2.1
document_date: 2017-10-17 (Council Order 0015479); the underlying order is dated 2017-07-24

facts.text: An accredited agency's order of 2017-07-24 under Division B 9.5.2 of ABC 2006 listed 14 contraventions; only item 11, the need for the south exit door to be barrier free, remained at issue.
The appeal concerns a two-storey building; the record includes an excerpt of ABC article 9.9.7.4 (number and spacing of egress doors) introduced by the respondent as Exhibit 1.
The building has a two-hour firewall with magnetic hold-open fire doors; the Panel confirmed with the appellant that the doors remain accessible to persons with disabilities when closed.
The Panel records that people staying at the hotel could seek refuge on the other side of the fire doors if a fire started on the lobby side.
The Panel states that there is a difference between access and egress under the ABC.
The Panel found the requirement that the south exit door be barrier free was not supported by the evidence or by ABC provisions, and revoked item 11.
